data.name: Moving Cleaning
data.heroSubheading: Specialized cleaning services for when you're moving out of your old place or into your new home. We ensure a smooth transition with professional, thorough cleaning.
data.includedSectionHeading: What's Included in Our Moving Cleaning
data.includedSectionSubheading: Our comprehensive moving cleaning service ensures your old or new home receives thorough attention for a seamless transition.

cleaningAreas.title: Move-Out Cleaning
cleaningAreas.description: Our move-out cleaning service ensures you leave your rental property in pristine condition, maximizing the chances of getting your security deposit back in full.
features: Deep cleaning of all rooms, including hard-to-reach areas
Wall cleaning and scuff/mark removal where possible
Appliance cleaning inside and out (if remaining)

cleaningAreas.title: Move-In Cleaning
cleaningAreas.description: Start fresh in your new home with our comprehensive move-in cleaning service, ensuring every surface is sanitized and ready for your belongings.
features: Sanitization of all surfaces, especially high-touch areas
Deep cleaning of bathrooms and kitchen
Thorough dusting of all surfaces and light fixtures

cleaningAreas.title: Post-Renovation Cleaning
cleaningAreas.description: If your new home has undergone renovations, our specialized cleaning removes dust, debris, and construction residue before you move in.
features: Removal of construction dust from all surfaces
Cleaning of vents and air ducts to remove debris
Final sanitization of all living spaces

data.benefitsSubheading: Why investing in professional moving cleaning services is essential for a smooth transition.
data.benefit1Description: Our thorough move-out cleaning significantly increases your chances of receiving your full security deposit back from your landlord.
data.benefit2Description: Let professionals handle the cleaning while you focus on the many other aspects of your move, significantly reducing your stress.
data.benefit3Description: Our sanitization process eliminates allergens, bacteria, and germs from previous occupants, creating a healthier environment in your new home.

faqs.question: Do I need to empty the house before moving cleaning?
faqs.answer: For best results, we recommend the space be as empty as possible. We can clean around remaining furniture or items, but empty spaces allow for a more thorough clean.

faqs.question: Can you clean after my movers finish?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can schedule your moving cleaning after your movers have finished, ensuring your old or new home is spotless before you settle in or hand over the keys.

faqs.question: What areas are included in a moving cleaning?
faqs.answer: Our moving cleaning covers all rooms, inside cabinets, appliances, and closets. We ensure the property is ready for move-in or move-out inspection.

faqs.question: What if I am not satisfied with the cleaning?
faqs.answer: If you are not completely satisfied, contact us within 24 hours and we will return to address any concerns at no additional cost.
